survey: A sci-fi moon base on cratered ground. Main parts: (1) A low, wide white cylinder sits flat on the ground and forms the habitat. Its top has a flat ring-shaped ledge. (2) A transparent blue glass dome sits on that ledge. A white collar seats it, about ten white ribs curve up over it, and the ribs all meet at a round cap at the top. The dome faces the camera at three-quarter view. (3) A horizontal cylindrical tunnel, or airlock, sticks out of the habitat wall toward the lower left. It is segmented, its inner end joins the wall cleanly, and it rests on two block feet on the ground. (4) The tunnel's outer end is a flat cap with a yellow rectangular door and a knob. The door's bottom edge is near ground level. (5) A metal ladder leans against the habitat wall. Its feet are on the ground and its top reaches the rim of the ledge, giving roof and maintenance access. Everything touches the ground or attaches to the main body. Nothing floats, the ribs are evenly spaced and meet at a single cap, and the door can be reached at ground level.
